summary: POST /v1/schema silently accepts string/bool for int-declared vectorIndexConfig params (dynamicEfMax, flatSearchCutoff), coercing to 0 with HTTP 200. Unsent dynamicEfMin defaults to 100 -> stored Min(100) > Max(0), violating inferred assertion weaviate_inferred_hnsw_ef_pairing_001. Control: float 12.7->422, string for replication factor->400, so gap is specific to vectorIndexConfig.
